entities.name: Genaro Hernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Genaro Hernández was a Mexican American professional boxer who competed from 1984 to 1998. Nicknamed "Chicanito" Hernandez, he went on to become a two-time super featherweight world champion, having held the WBA title from 1991 to 1995, and the WBC and lineal titles from 1997 to 1998. Additionally, he challenged for the WBO lightweight title in 1995.
